skeleton: ladybug standing, three-quarter view facing right: root on the ground; body (the dark underside) with belly squash; shell (red spotted, closed) on the body, hinged at its front so it lifts; clear wings under the shell (shown when it lifts or flies); head at the front-right, face with eyes and mouth; antennaL/antennaR; six legs (near in front, far behind, shaded).

sheets.prompt:
Image 1 is a sticker of a ladybug character. Draw this exact ladybug as a cut-out paper puppet: its separate body parts laid out on one sheet, the same drawing style, colours, texture, line and proportions as in image 1, every part at the size it has in image 1.

Draw each part on its own, spread out over the sheet with wide empty gaps between them, no part touching or overlapping another:
1. the shell: the big red domed shell with its black spots, closed, as in image 1, alone.
2. the body underneath: the dark brown underside of the ladybug's body that the shell sits on, alone.
3. the head: the round dark head with its cream face area, facing right as in image 1, with a completely blank face — no eyes, no mouth — keep the rosy cheeks; no antennae.
4. one antenna: a dark antenna with a round tip.
5. one clear wing: a thin clear veined wing, spread out, with a rounded root.
6. one leg: a dark bent leg with a little foot.

Every part is drawn whole, including what is normally hidden behind another part, and each joint end (where it tucks under the body or the head) is a full, smooth, rounded edge. No text, no labels, no numbers, no outline around the parts beyond the drawing's own line, no shadows. Fully transparent background.

Image 1 is a sticker of a ladybug character; image 2 shows the same ladybug cut into puppet parts, with a blank face. Draw the ladybug's face pieces as separate stickers on one sheet: the same drawing style, colours and line as in image 1, every piece at the size it has on the ladybug in image 1, so it fits the blank face in image 2.

Draw each piece on its own, spread out in tidy rows with wide empty gaps between them, nothing touching:
1. the ladybug's left eye (on the right of image 1) as it is in image 1: a big dark round eye with a white sparkle.
2. the same eye wide open and surprised: bigger and rounder, with its white sparkle.
3. the same eye gently closed in sleep: a soft downward-curving line with a few lashes.
4. the same eye closed in a happy smile: an upward-curving arc.
5. the same eye sad: looking down, its upper lid tilted up towards the middle.
6. the mouth as it is in image 1: a small happy smile.
7. the mouth wide open in a big happy laugh, the inside pink.
8. the mouth open in a small round 'o'.
9. the mouth in a small sad frown.

No text, no labels, no numbers, no shadows, no face or head around the pieces. Fully transparent background.

the ladybug crouches, jumps up high for joy with its wings out, and lands with a little squash.
the ladybug does a happy little dance, swaying from side to side and tapping its little legs.
the ladybug shakes its head no.
the ladybug looks one way, then the other, then back.
the ladybug laughs and laughs, bouncing with giggles.
the ladybug talks, its mouth moving, its head bobbing a little.
the ladybug shivers and trembles, cold or scared.
the ladybug cries, head down, shoulders shaking with little sobs.
the ladybug gives a big yawn, tucks its head down, closes its eyes and falls asleep, then wakes up, blinks and smiles.
